title: The Hand Reads Too
summary: Silas of the Gilded Hand has read the Warden Journal you sold him. He's pleased, and paying a bonus, and he wants you to know the cult will be very interested in where he got it.

quest_book.title: A Bonus
quest_book.author: Silas of the Gilded Hand
pages:
The journal sold beautifully.

Come and collect your bonus. Bring a bag.

- S.

threats.name: Silas of the Gilded Hand
threats.target_line: My favourite supplier! I owe you money. Isn't that nice?
talk: To pay you. The journal was worth every emerald. More, actually.
What will you do with it?
Sell it again. To the people you're fighting. Business is business.
